source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.why_warranted: The exact geometry, endpoint minima, saddle location, excluded collision point, and normal coordinate are explicit but only described in formulas and prose; a sketch could connect the chart and path claim.
source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.specific_content_maps_relations_to_draw_: Draw the annular sector in the (x1,x2)-plane with excluded center C_bad=(0,0), inner/outer radii 3/4 and 5/4, sector angles ±π/4, and the unit-circle arc from angle −π/6 to +π/6. Mark X(−a,0) and X(a,0) as minima, X(0,0) as the index-one saddle, and show tangent T(s) and normal N(s) at one path point. Keep the path endpoints distinct from the wider sector boundary; do not put C_bad in U or depict n as an angular coordinate.

source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.why_warranted: The statement relates a negative eigendirection, its perturbed dimer direction, a local Hessian gap, translation reflection, and an invariant error ball; these geometric roles are not visually represented in prose.
source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.specific_content_maps_relations_to_draw_: In a two-dimensional local schematic, draw saddle x_* with the unique negative Hessian eigendirection q_* and stable transverse direction; at iterate x show accepted dimer direction v with its angle bound to q_x and the perturbation from q_x to q_*. Signal that the validated eigenvalue gap and accepted-mode hypotheses are required at every attempted iterate.
